messages:
Amy C: Heads-up — EU p99 spike just hit SLO. I'm putting a hold on any active releases in eu for the next window. @OpsOnCall can you confirm and @DeployBot pause canaries?
DeployBot: /deploy pause --region=eu --scope=canary --reason='slo-spike' — paused 6 pipelines. Will auto-expire based on thread.
OpsOnCall: Investigating. Seeing a p99 jump on transcoder nodes after last night's infra change (kernel/cgroup tune). Running deeper checks, ETA ~30m.
Sanjay P: If kernel tweak is the culprit we should rollback infra before continuing releases. Can infra team rollback the change safely?
Marco R: Recommend pinning app releases that were in-flight to v2.4.1 and blocking any new rollouts until we confirm infra baseline. Also requeue non-urgent releases to next change window (Mon 03:00 UTC).
Amy C: Good call. Sanjay, if rollback isn't quick we'll extend hold to Mon 03:00 UTC and notify customers.
OpsOnCall: Rolling rollback started: kernel-rollback job on eu-transcoder-1..3. Progress 2/3. Will update when complete.
DeployBot: Note: paused pipelines annotated with tag "incident-gatehold-1719204444". To resume manually: `/deploy resume --thread=1719204444`. Auto-unpause scheduled at 1719210800 unless canceled.
Chloe L: I'll add a short release-note blurb and update the change calendar. Calendar invite for Mon 03:00 UTC sent to release-owners.
Marco R: Release-note draft added: "Hold applied due to EU latency incident; in-flight releases pinned to v2.4.1; scheduled requeue Mon 03:00 UTC. Contact @release-managers for exceptions."
OpsOnCall: Rollback finished on all nodes. Metrics trending back to baseline (p50/p90/p99). Recommend canary resume once QA gives green.
Amy C: QA team, any objections? If none, I'll ask DeployBot to resume EU canaries now.
QA (via Chloe L): Quick smoke passed on a sample canary run. No obvious regressions.
Amy C: :thumbsup: Resuming now.
DeployBot: /deploy resume --region=eu --scope=canary --thread=1719204444 — resumed canaries. Monitoring mode: 30m, auto-rollback if p99 > 2500ms. Logs: https://kibana.company.local/app/discover#/view/incident-1719204444
Marco R: Leaving release pin in place for the rest of the day. Ops, please post final postmortem entry and I'll update release schedule after monitoring window.
OpsOnCall: Will post postmortem and add timeline. Will update this thread when we close the incident.
